Author: Claude, 2026-08-15. For review by Travis, GPT, Fable.
Three complaints arrived together, and they have one cause:
Replay does not record lane scrolling, window clicking, resizes, program launches — it captures
4 of ~15 verbs the desktop actually has.
(Now built — see §6. They survive this proposal.)
There is no way to expose the desktop's programmability to WRL in a code editor.
The cause is that the recording is an ad-hoc
shape invented for one feature. Fixing (1) by adding eleven more
values makes (3) permanently harder, because the "API" would then be whatever the recorder happened to log.
One decision fixes all three: a closed vocabulary of typed ops, applied through a single seam.
